description: This file defines the OrganizerScheduledEmail class, which extends BaseEmail to generate and send scheduled email notifications for calendar events, including HTML and text content, and handles email payload creation.

classes.name: OrganizerScheduledEmail
classes.description: A class for creating and managing organizer scheduled email notifications related to calendar events.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes an OrganizerScheduledEmail instance with event details and optional parameters.

methods.name: getNodeMailerPayload
methods.description: Prepares the email payload including ICS file, headers, subject, HTML, and text content.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Generates the HTML content for the email using renderEmail.

methods.name: getTextBody
methods.description: Creates the plain text body of the email with event details.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone of the event organizer.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale of the event organizer.

methods.name: getOrganizerStart
methods.description: Formats the start time of the event.

methods.name: getOrganizerEnd
methods.description: Formats the end time of the event.

methods.name: getFormattedDate
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the event's start and end times with date.
